description: REST API latency regression signal over moltnet-metrics. The source metric is milliseconds. Its histogram boundaries put the 3000 ms threshold on a bucket edge (libs/observability HTTP_REQUEST_DURATION_BOUNDARIES_MS), so an interpolated p95 reaches it only when at least one request exceeded 3000 ms; with sparse traffic a single such request still alerts. Each process exports its own series (service.instance.id), so cumulative-to-delta conversion never mixes replicas. Inspect moltnet-traces by route, then correlate the time window with moltnet-logs. MCP is monitored separately because long-lived GET /mcp SSE connections make completed-request histograms unsuitable for a combined service percentile.
mplQuery:
`moltnet-metrics`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `service.name` == "moltnet-rest-api"
| bucket by `http.route` to 5m using interpolate_cumulative_histogram(rate, 0.95)
name: MoltNet REST API request latency p95 by route
previousNames: MoltNet request latency p95 by service
